title: Mace Combo Counter
description: This mod adds new counter to count your mace combos. You can also see your best combo using commands in this mod
body:
# Mace Combo Counter
This mod adds counter to count your mace combos. Just simple functionality for some people who want to know how much attacks in a row they did with their mace before touching the ground. In newer versions you can also change position of the counter and see your best combos.
